purpose: Show how cargo variety and two delivery stops define the trailer loading problem.
headline: One trailer, two deliveries
subtitle: Different load units share the same space and rear doors.
takeaway: The stop order determines which cargo needs to be at the doors.
caption: Figure 1. Conceptual setup for seven cargo types sharing one rear-unload trailer and two delivery stops.
alt_text: Different cargo shapes share one 48-ft semitrailer, with two deliveries through its rear doors.
source_notes: Seven cargo rows, 133 fixed units and two active groups in the 48ft-semitrailer-two-stop-mixed-cargo preset. Nominal 48-ft case. Sample shapes illustrate variety without depicting exact quantities or the solved placement.
